svg.text: Mooring, alert load pin and chain
1. Dimensions in millimetres. Do not scale.
2. WL: waterline moored, with the hanging chain (9.6 kg in water).
3. Top 1675 mm above the sea (brief 1400 to 1800); green
buoy 1697 mm; 1723 mm if the chain breaks.
5. Mass 173.4 kg (CAD). GM 229 mm: stable, 19° heel in a gale.
green float and lens, cone topmark (37) for the can (36).
7. All metal 316L stainless or galvanised, with a zinc anode (22).
8. 3 x 20 W solar panels, 12.8 V 40 Ah battery in a locked,
9. Load pin (39) in the shackle: if the pull drops to zero the
chain has broken; GNSS tracker sends an alert and position.
10. Each part has its own drawing ESP24-Pnn (nn = item).
Third angle projection. Drawn from the CAD model with hidden line removal.
